description: Cemiplimab with platinum-based chemotherapy can be used as an option for untreated non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults who would otherwise be offered pembrolizumab with platinum-based chemotherapy, when the cancer is locally advanced and not suitable for definitive chemoradiation, or is metastatic, has PD-L1 in 1% or more of the tumour cells, and has no EGFR, ALK or ROS-1 aberrations.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended cemiplimab with platinum-based chemotherapy as an option for untreated non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults who would otherwise be offered pembrolizumab with platinum-based chemotherapy, when the cancer is locally advanced and not suitable for definitive chemoradiation, or is metastatic, has PD-L1 in 1% or more of the tumour cells, and has no EGFR, ALK or ROS-1 aberrations. Cemiplimab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
